title: Why Did a 90-Day Mars Rover Last 14 Years?

notes.text: At 6 hours: nothing is broken. It is public, in HD, with no restrictions, and the listing matches what was approved. It has 45 views and ranks 8th of our last 10 at this age, because YouTube has shown it to few people so far. The people who were shown it stayed: 68 in 100 watched where 32 is usual for us, from a small sample. So the opening works and nothing in the edit needs changing. No re-cut and no new upload. One small listing fix is queued: the video's language was never set. This is the second slow start this week, after the Titan Short. If Thursday's Mars Short starts slowly too, the thing in common is Mars rover Shorts back to back, and the coming weeks' Shorts get spread across subjects. Next look: tomorrow morning's numbers.
